jewelry.desc: Jewelry Management is an end-to-end system for gold and jewelry stores: from PIN-login cashier transactions and master stock at tens of thousands of SKUs, to daily cash sessions, buyback, repairs, and daily, monthly, and yearly reports. Built specifically for how the gold industry works — grams, purity, and value are always tracked.

loge.desc: Loge Knowledge AI unifies your company's private knowledge — documents, wikis, tickets, even code — into a single AI assistant. Every answer always shows its sources, so your team can trust and verify every piece of information.
